item.title: Research notes: reading a paper from scratch
item.description: My "three-pass" approach to reading papers, and how I work through a top-conference paper in a week — what to focus on at each step, from title and abstract to experimental design, plus the pitfalls to avoid.

item.title: Managing Python project configuration: environment variables, config files and secrets
item.description: A Python project usually needs different configuration across environments (development, testing, production). This article collects the configuration approaches I use most, and when each of them fits.
